segments.text: A jet breaks apart ten kilometres up. One crew member falls all the way down, with no parachute.
No chance. Nobody falls ten kilometres and lives. Let's go look.
January {1972|nineteen seventy-two}. Vesna {Vulović|Voolovitch} isn't even meant to be on this flight. The airline mixed her up with another Vesna.
Then, mid-flight, a bomb in the baggage hold tears the plane apart.
{27|Twenty-seven} people are killed. Vesna is pinned inside the wreckage by a food trolley.
It falls {10,000|ten thousand} metres, and hits a snowy, wooded hillside at an angle.
A villager hears screams in the wreck. He was a wartime medic. He keeps her alive.
Broken skull, broken legs, broken spine. Ten months later, she walks.
Some reporters later doubted the height. The record still stands. I was wrong. Case closed.
